Subject: Quick follow-up: usage and help for OliveTech trial

Hi Sara — hope the onboarding checklist was helpful. I pulled your usage metrics today and wanted to flag low activation: since the top-up, only ~430 tokens consumed (about 3.4% of the top-up).

Common blockers we see at this stage:
- Example prompts not wired into the right endpoint
- SDK keys used in a non-production project (tokens allocated elsewhere)
- Rate limits on long demo prompts causing timeouts

Would you be open to a 15-minute troubleshooting call this week? I can loop in an engineer and we can triage live for rapid fixes. If you'd prefer, Priyom has a short activation playbook we can run (quick A/B prompts + caching tips).

If we don't hear back, we typically leave the promo active until expiry (2026-07-15), but if you want a targeted extension or an additional small top-off for demo day, we can consider another 25% increase.

Thanks,
Dylan
